item.title: Starmer says he is 'not going to yield' to pressure from Trump on Iran war
item.summary: It follows a warning from the US president that America's trade deal with the UK "can always be changed".

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Israel and Hezbollah continue attacks after Israel-Lebanon talks in US
item.summary: Israel strikes hit southern Lebanon and Hezbollah fires rockets at Israel, a day after rare direct negotiations.

item.title: Chris Mason: Iran war has trapped Labour in a vicious circle
item.summary: A subdued economy makes trade-offs and choices over public spending more difficult, Chris Mason writes.

item.title: Sri Lanka repatriates 238 Iranian sailors stranded after US torpedo attack
item.summary: The survivors of the US attack on Iranian vessel Iris Dena, which claimed the lives of 104 people, were among those sent home.

item.title: Manhunt after attempted arson attack on synagogue
item.summary: Police say two suspects threw petrol-filled bottles at Finchley Reform Synagogue but they did not ignite.

item.title: Watch: Moment gunman tackled by school principal in Oklahoma
item.summary: CCTV footage shows a high school principal charging towards a former student who was armed in Oklahoma.

item.title: Four killed in second Turkish school shooting in two days
item.summary: Three students and one teacher died in the attack, according to the local governor.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Two officers charged after pregnant woman killed in crash with police car
item.summary: The woman and her unborn child died in a crash with a police car in Kidbrooke, south-east London.

item.title: Booking.com customers warned of 'reservation hijacking' after hack
item.summary: The travel platform said it had changed Pins to protect customers but would not say how many were affected.

item.title: How many ships are crossing the Strait of Hormuz?
item.summary: Since the start of the US blockade on Monday, 15 vessels have crossed the Strait of Hormuz, nine of which have links to Iran, BBC Verify analysis of ship-tracking data suggests.
